entries.0cbb77e871e1c6d0: A specialized bolt manufacturer that produces hexagon bolts, special bolts, and more in an integrated process from raw material to heat treatment, mainly for construction machinery.
entries.476ab406823f915f: This division manufactures forged products, namely parts with shaft sections used in automobiles and other vehicles, and components for transmission machinery. Its products include hollow parts for steering, pinion shafts for steering, rod bolts for suspension support, and adjusters for brakes, among others. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥102 million.
entries.476c237d0b1ab438: This division manufactures fastening parts for machinery and fastening bolts used when embedded in narrow spaces. Its products include JIS-standard hexagon bolts and hexagon socket head bolts, among others. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥103 million.
entries.6a67e9d6c7aedcb4: This business involves manufacturing hexagon bolts, hexagon socket bolts, special bolts and other products as a specialist bolt manufacturer, using cold forging, hot forging and an integrated production system from raw materials through heat treatment, and selling them to industries including construction machinery, automotive-related and industrial machinery. Consolidated subsidiary Kyowa Workstyle Co., Ltd. performs plating on the company's products, and equity-method affiliate Netsuren Komatsu Co., Ltd. performs induction hardening on shafts for continuously variable transmissions. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥10,828 million.
entries.7bbc127dabf1c115: This segment manufactures bolts for internal combustion engines in ships and generators, and bolts for large-scale buildings such as gymnasiums and stadiums. Its products include bolts for medium and large diesel engines, bolts for truss-structure buildings, bolts for seismic isolation structures, and rebar joints for construction. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥250 million.
entries.8a782070ac65cbff: Businesses in the ship, generator and construction fields
entries.94ffcaf1b696567f: Construction Machinery Bolt Manufacturing and Sales Business
entries.a70d1ebfbf6d2068: A division that manufactures fastening bolts for the crawler track shoes and bucket parts (dozer blades) of bulldozers and other machines, shoe bolts and nuts, fastening bolts for rock drill equipment, and reduction gear parts for power shovel swing rings, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥10,373 million.
entries.ec2ed4400bb84c88: Businesses in the industrial machinery industry
entries.ff4667b21119b88a: Operators in the construction machinery, automotive-related and industrial machinery industries, including construction machinery manufacturers
